brief:
Airstrikes struck an industrial facility in the Tel al-Hawa area near the Jordanian Hospital in western Gaza City, the Ma'an news agency reported. Powerful explosions shook the area, with thick columns of smoke and fire rising from the site.

The strikes occurred in a densely populated residential and commercial district. Further details on casualties or the extent of damage were not immediately available.

title: Strike hits industrial facility west of Gaza City
